descriptionByLocale.en:
Your tasks
• Responsibility for the support, configuration, testing and further development of the ERP system opal, telephony (Siemens), patient media terminals and other administrative applications
• User support incl. On-call service
• Integration and ensuring the stable operation of end devices and applications
• Support of IT projects and support in patch management
• Creation and maintenance of system and operating manuals Participation in innovative projects as a specialist, as well as management of sub-projects Your profile
• Training as a computer scientist EFZ or several years of experience in the IT sector
• Good knowledge of IT support (operation and introduction of IT specialist solutions)
• Experience in hospital operation or handling of technical/medical equipment advantageous
• Knowledge of ITIL processes advantageous
• Reliable and solution-oriented personality
• Good oral and written communication
• Pleasure in working with various professional groups Well-groomed appearance and good manners In addition, you benefit from
• Other attractive benefits Admission: 01 September 2026
